notes:
v0.3.43 - everything in 0.3.41, plus the 97% update fix

Same as 0.3.41 (the agent can work the app itself, and remembers out loud) with
the update fix that went to everyone as 0.3.42 folded in:

FIXED: the update could sit at 97% and never move, then give up after three
minutes and tell you to reinstall the companion app. The companion app had
almost always updated perfectly - the page just had no way to tell, because it
was asking a part of the companion app that needs a password it does not have.
It now asks something it can actually read.

Everything 0.3.41 added is still here: the setup questions can be restarted by
asking, the agent can read and correct what it knows about your business,
standing instructions about language and tone stick, scheduled posts can be
cancelled and escalations cleared, and it can tell you what version and which AI
model it is running.

NOT IN THIS BUILD: sending a direct message to somebody who has not written to
you first. Still turned off while the part that finds a person in Instagram's
message box is tested.
